strings.zh: 桐树林里面有一片树林{NEWLINE}被人称为时光森林,{CLEAR}里面错综复杂很容易迷路,{CLEAR}如果你想进入时光森林,{CLEAR}最好提前记录一下旅行的信息。
strings.en: Deep inside Ilex Forest there’s a grove{NEWLINE}people call the Forest of Time. It’s a{CLEAR}real maze, and it’s easy to get lost. If{CLEAR}you want to go into the Forest of Time,{CLEAR}you’d better save your journey first.
strings.notes: 时光森林 → the Forest of Time (hack name, invented).

strings.zh: 传说桐树林里居住着{NEWLINE}两只罕见的草系精灵,{CLEAR}分别是能够穿越时空的雪拉比{CLEAR}和能够净化一切的洁咪。{SCROLL}至于怎么找到这两只精灵{NEWLINE}就不得而知了。{CLEAR}不过有一只说法是{CLEAR}雪拉比只在夜晚出现,{CLEAR}而洁咪只在白天出现。
strings.en: Legend says two rare Grass-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon live in Ilex Forest: Celebi,{CLEAR}which can travel through time, and{CLEAR}Shaymin, which can purify anything.{SCROLL}Nobody knows how to find them,{NEWLINE}though. But one story goes that{CLEAR}Celebi only appears at night, and{CLEAR}Shaymin only appears during the day.

strings.zh: 最近桐树林突然出现了{NEWLINE}大量虫系精灵,{CLEAR}严重影响到了原生的草系精灵,{CLEAR}目前阿笔馆主正带人在里面{CLEAR}进行捕虫工作,{CLEAR}所以桐树林暂时禁止通行。
strings.en: Lately a huge number of Bug-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon have suddenly appeared in Ilex{CLEAR}Forest, and they’re badly hurting the{CLEAR}native Grass types. Bugsy is leading{CLEAR}a team in there to catch the bugs,{CLEAR}so Ilex Forest is closed for now.

strings.zh: 吔『嘿,你好呀,{NEWLINE}我是喜欢穿便装的舞女吔。{CLEAR}你刚刚从桐树林路过吧？{CLEAR}我和我小梅姐姐约了在这见面,{CLEAR}她应该也是像你一样{CLEAR}从桐树林南边穿过来。{SCROLL}吔『但她是个大路痴,{NEWLINE}我很担心她在树林里迷路出不来。{CLEAR}如果你在树林里遇到了小梅姐姐,{CLEAR}麻烦你把她带到这里来好吗？
strings.en: Sakura: Hey there, hello! I’m Sakura,{NEWLINE}the Kimono Girl who likes to wear casual{CLEAR}clothes. You just came through Ilex{CLEAR}Forest, right? I promised to meet my big{CLEAR}sister Koume here. She should be coming{CLEAR}through the forest from the south,{CLEAR}just like you.{SCROLL}Sakura: But she has a terrible sense of{NEWLINE}direction, and I’m worried she’s lost in{CLEAR}the woods and can’t get out. If you run{CLEAR}into Koume in the forest, could you{CLEAR}please bring her here?
strings.notes: 吔 = Aya (0719 #801 placeholder), youngest of the five Kimono Girl sisters; 小梅 = Koume (romanised JP like Tamao/Momo). | [D-0959 rename 2026-09-29: Aya → Sakura]; ext-review RA-H04

strings.zh: 听说洁咪是很有洁癖的精灵,{NEWLINE}对于它不喜欢的属性的精灵{CLEAR}从来不会主动去靠近。
strings.en: I hear Shaymin is a real neat{NEWLINE}freak. It never goes near{CLEAR}Pokémon of types it doesn’t like.

strings.zh: 从这里向北不远就能到达{NEWLINE}城都的第一大城市满金市,{CLEAR}那是座不输给关东金黄市、彩虹市的{CLEAR}超繁华大都市哦。
strings.en: Just a little way north of here{NEWLINE}is Goldenrod City, the biggest{CLEAR}city in Johto. It’s a bustling{CLEAR}metropolis every bit as grand as{CLEAR}Saffron and Celadon in Kanto!
